_note: AI director (ENG-08 stage 1), navigation (stage 2) and the Foamer brain (stage 3). Units: seconds, counts, metres, degrees. Attack tokens: a Foamer may only attack while it holds a token of its attack kind, so only a few Foamers attack at once and arenas stay intense but fair (PLAN.md 4.3).

brain._note: The Foamer brain (ENG-08 stage 3): idle, alert, approach, hold, then the attack and damage states the Foamer already had. sightRangeMetres: an idle Foamer goes alert when the player is this close and in line of sight. alertRadiusMetres: an idle Foamer also goes alert when another Foamer this close goes alert, so a fight spreads through the room. alertTimeSeconds: the telegraph at the start of alert, a head turn to the player, before it moves. repathSeconds: how often an approaching Foamer asks the nav grid for a new path (it also re-paths when the grid re-bakes). holdRangeMetres: without an attack token a Foamer circles the player at this distance instead of crowding, and asks for a token again every step. sightEndMarginMetres: the line of sight ray stops this short of the player's eye, which sits inside the player's capsule (radius 0.35), so the player's own body never blocks the view. holdExitMarginMetres: a holding Foamer only goes back to approach once the player is this far past holdRange, so the two states do not flap back and forth at the boundary. tokenMinDistanceMetres: a bid scores closeness as 1 / max(distance, this), so a Foamer standing on the player does not win by an unbounded margin. tokenSightScore: the score a bid adds when the player is in line of sight. tokenWaitPerSecond: the score a bid adds for every second spent asking without a token, so no Foamer starves. circleRampMetres: a holding Foamer's step in or out of the ring reaches full speed once it is this far off holdRange. circleStrafeShare: the part of its speed the sidle keeps while it also steps in or out, so the circle does not stall while it settles. circleDeadbandMetres: no step in or out at all while it is this close to the ring, which stops it hunting back and forth.

pack._note: GAME-10d: the Swarmer pack. maxAlive is the hard cap on live Swarmers: a pack spawn past it is skipped, never made by removing the oldest, so a swarm never outruns the frame budget. ringMetres is the ring a Swarmer backs out to after a nibble and waits on, nibbleGapSeconds how long it must wait there before it may nibble again, and spreadMetres how far round the ring the members are placed.

nav._note: Walkable grid baked from the physics world (ENG-08 stage 2), not a navmesh: carves and falling pieces change the level every few seconds, and a grid re-bakes a small rectangle in well under a millisecond. cellMetres: side of one cell. topMetres: the bake casts down from this height to find the ground. maxSlopeDeg: a cell whose ground normal is steeper than this is not walkable. agentRadiusMetres and agentHeightMetres: the shape cast standing on a cell; a cell that hits anything with that shape is not walkable. maxStepMetres: the tallest step an agent walks up between neighbours (and the spacing under which a surface counts as a step, not a second layer). maxLayers: the most walkable surfaces one cell can hold, lowest first: the Pit's ring hangs 3 m over pit floor, and both the floor and the ring top are places an agent can stand (BUG-01 round 2). rebakeMarginMetres: a rectangle re-bake also redoes the cells this far outside it (one agent radius, so a change next to a cell is seen from that cell's shape cast). stringPull: simplify a path to the fewest waypoints when a straight line between two of them clears every cell it crosses.

steer._note: Steering (ENG-08 stage 2), a pure function of position, path and neighbours. arriveRadiusMetres: inside this of the last waypoint the desired speed falls off to zero. separationMetres: two agents closer than this push apart. separationGain: the push speed per metre of overlap (1/s), so two agents touching at half the separation drift apart at about 0.7 m/s. stallWindowSeconds and stallDistanceMetres: a walking Foamer that covers less than this distance in this long is stuck (a corner, another Foamer in the way, a path point inside a wall), and sidesteps for sidestepSeconds at sidestepShare of its speed instead of standing still (BUG-01).

story._note: Story preset (D10). Fewest Foamers attacking at once.

fury._note: Foam Fury preset. Most Foamers attacking at once.
